proposal.quote: propagate value from them down through answering notes and their subroutines
proposal.change: Replace the coined term "subroutine" with the note's own ordinary wording throughout its two occurrences: "their subroutines" becomes "the notes that answer their sub-questions" (giving "propagate value from them down through answering notes and the notes that answer their sub-questions"), and "subroutine reuse" in the Combining-dimensions bullet becomes "sub-question reuse".
proposal.reason: "Subroutine" is not registered in the KB vocabulary and no linked note defines it. In this note it names the same thing the first bullet already calls "sub-questions": a note that answers a local sub-question raised inside another note, measured by weighted inbound links. No occurrence needs a distinction that "sub-question" lacks. Swapping between the two words makes one thing look like two. kb-role lists neither the term nor these bullets as relied on.

decisions.reason: The operator preferred the more direct alternative: reuse of answers to sub-questions.

proposal.change: Replace "demand-root coverage" with "root-question coverage" (the only occurrence).
proposal.reason: "Demand-root" is coined here and nowhere else in the KB. It names the **root questions** the first Unsettled bullet introduces. The ordinary phrase used there carries the same claim. Keeping a second name for the same root makes the reader wonder whether it is a separate signal. kb-role does not list it as relied on.
